functions.name: findPiso
functions.signature: int findPiso (float a3333, float pl, float gx, float gz, float *px, float *pz, float *vgx, float *vgz, float *g11, float *g13, float *g33, int r)
functions.purpose: Finds the reflected or transmitted isotropic P-wave slowness, group velocity, and polarization components.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: Uses float arithmetic and the double-precision sqrt function for transmission; rounding near zero in the discriminant determines whether the root is rejected.

functions.name: findSiso
functions.signature: int findSiso (float a1313, float pl, float gx, float gz, float *px, float *pz, float *vgx, float *vgz, float *g11, float *g13, float *g33, int r)
functions.purpose: Finds the reflected or transmitted isotropic S-wave slowness, group velocity, and polarization components.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: Uses float arithmetic and the double-precision sqrt function for transmission; rounding near zero in the discriminant determines whether the root is rejected.

functions.name: findqSH
functions.signature: int findqSH(float si, float co, float pl, float a1212, float a1223, float a2323, float *pxnew, float *pznew, float *vgx, float *vgz, int r)
functions.purpose: Solves for reflected or transmitted quasi-SH slowness and group velocity across an interface.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: Solves a quadratic using float intermediates and double-precision sqrt; the 0.5 literal promotes the root expression to double. Discriminant, FLT_EPSILON, and group-velocity sign tests are sensitive near their boundaries, and the quadratic formula can suffer cancellation.

functions.name: rottensh
functions.signature: void rottensh (float *a1212, float *a2323, float *a1223, float si, float co )
functions.purpose: Rotates the three independent components of a two-dimensional SH stiffness tensor in place.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: Uses float products and sums whose evaluation order affects rounding, particularly when terms cancel; input components are saved before outputs are written.

functions.name: rottensor
functions.signature: void rottensor (float *a1111, float *a3333, float *a1133, float *a1313, float *a1113, float *a3313, float si, float co )
functions.purpose: Rotates the six independent components of a two-dimensional elastic stiffness tensor in place.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: Uses long expressions of float products and sums; preserve expression order to limit rounding differences, especially for cancellation. Input components are saved before outputs are written.
